terza rima.definition:
A peculiar and complicated system of versification,
   borrowed by the early Italian poets from the Troubadours.
terza rima.translation: [意]三行体(象旦丁《神曲》中所用的诗体, 三行为一节, 每节的第二行与下一节的第一、三行押韵, 如：aba, bcb, cdc)

terzet.translation: <意>n.[音]三重唱,三重奏[字面意义： trio]

terzetto.definition: n the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one
terzetto.translation: <意>n.[音]三重唱,三重奏[字面意义：trio]
